shots.say: Drip, drop! Oh, it's raining! And my feathers are all soggy!
Hello, I'm Milo! We are on the way to Mango's tree house. This is Mango, the spider monkey.
And this is Tumble, the baby elephant.
I like the rain! Splish, splash!
Not me! Soggy feathers are no fun.
Come on, friends! My tree house is this way.
Let's find an umbrella! Then we can all stay dry on the way to my tree house.
What keeps you dry in the rain? An umbrella, or a spoon?
The jungle is a rainforest. And a rainforest gets lots and lots of rain.
In some rainforests, it rains more than an inch every day!
shots.tag: fact: more than an inch a day

shots.say: Here's a leaf! You try it first, Milo.
Ooh, nice and dry! Now you, Tumble.
Hmm. The leaf is too small for my big head!
Is the leaf big, or small?
On they go, through the rainy jungle. Squish, squash, go Tumble's feet.
In the meadow, big pink flowers grow.
A flower hat! Pretty, and dry!
Drip! Drip! The rain runs right through the petals.
And a flower is much too small for an elephant!
Can an elephant fit under a flower? Yes, or no?
By the little stream, there is an old log, with soft green moss.
Moss is soft, like a hat. I'll make one for Milo!
Milo puts on the moss hat. Squish! Water drips out.
Oh! It's soggy and drippy, just like me!
How many drops fall from the hat? Count with me! One. Two. Three!
The friends rest under the big tree. Still wet, and the tree house is far away.
A leaf, a flower, a moss hat. Everything is too small.
Maybe we can't stay dry today.
We are wet, but we are together. That's okay.
What do we need now? Something small, or something big?
Look! Little white bats, under that leaf!
The bats fold the leaf down, like a tent. Inside, they stay nice and dry.
Some little bats snip and fold a big leaf to make a tent. It keeps the rain off!
A leaf tent! That's it! We need a leaf. A giant one!
A little bat named Puff peeks out, and smiles.
And there, on the ground! A giant leaf has fallen down.
Mango pulls and pulls. But it is too heavy for one little monkey.
Let's lift it together! I can hold the stem with my trunk.
What can good friends do? Work alone, or work together?
Count with me! One. Two. Three. Lift! Up goes the giant leaf.
It's a big green umbrella! Mango, Tumble and Milo all fit underneath.
Puff flies over. Is there room for one more?
Of course, Puff! There is room for all!
How many friends are under the leaf? Count with me! One. Two. Three. Four!
Drip, drop, drip, drop, hear the rain. Under our leaf, we're dry again!
Here is Mango's tree house! And look, the rain has stopped.
shots.tag: the tree house, the rain stops

shots.say: A rainbow! And my feathers are drying in the sun.
Up, up goes Mango, all the way to the top of the trees.
Way up high is the canopy. Most animals in the rainforest live up here, in the canopy!
shots.tag: fact: most animals live in the canopy

shots.say: Mango brings fruit for everyone. A tree house party!
Thank you for the umbrella idea, Mango.
We did it together. And Puff showed us the way!
Thank you, Puff! See you soon!
Back at the zoo, the sky is pink. And Mama is waiting.
Mama! We made an umbrella, from a giant leaf!
What a clever idea. You all worked together. I am so proud of you.
Mama wraps her trunk around Tumble. A big, warm trunk hug.
When a job is too big for one, we can do it together. And there is always room for one more friend.
Do you remember? What did the little bats make from a leaf? A tent, or a boat?
Where do most rainforest animals live? In the treetops, or in the mud?
And how many friends fit under the giant leaf? Two, or four?
Drip, drop, drip, drop, hear the rain. Under our leaf, we're dry again!
Next time: Sandy and the flying scarf! See you on the next adventure, friends!
